repositories.finding: Current repository calls the system FAFO. It is a pipeline-aware evaluation/attribution/variant workflow orchestrated by an external coding agent, not a drop-in Pareto optimizer. Its action space can include prompts, skills, parameters and graph structure.
repositories.adaptation: Use measured edit outcomes and complete-task scoped revisions. Do not widen this benchmark to model changes, retrieval or agentic pipelines.

repositories.finding: A literature catalogue, not an optimizer implementation or a performance guarantee.
repositories.adaptation: Use as an index; do not claim its listed algorithms are implemented by importing the list.

repositories.finding: Benchmark wrappers around existing optimizers, with explicit task/predictor setup and token-limit callbacks; benchmark tasks include SST-5/GSM8K.
repositories.adaptation: Preserve reproducible common settings, token budgets and actual rendered prompt semantics. It does not supply a fairness-aware method.

repositories.finding: MO-CAPO creates Prompt objects with their attached demonstrations and races challengers over common blocks. Baseline NSGA-II uses full evaluation; original study focuses on quality/cost.
repositories.adaptation: Repair effective demonstrations and retain diverse Pareto parent candidates. Do not transplant arithmetic block averaging to nonlinear group fairness or silently alter baseline evaluation.
